entry.title: dotnet/roslyn - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-18
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Visual Studio 2026 is Not Responding when clicking on dropdown to view list of variables and functions on Navigation Bar #82449
  • Targeted attribute list on `extension` block causes compiler crash #82445
  • Adding attributes to `extension` block has uninformative error message #82444
  • Assertion Failed: Analyzed 42 nodes in NullableWalker, but DebugVerifier expects 6 #82441

Closed

  • Go to definition (or implementation) not working as expected on Visual Studio 2026 #81510
  • It looks like IsEqualEvaluation is missing a type check for indexer evaluations #82398
    18.5
  • Unable to evaluate local functions #60358
    .NET 11
  • Compiler crash (FailFast) in RefSafetyAnalysis when using 'nameof' on an indexer #82440
  • No error when using nameof(collection[index]). Instead the compiler crashes on build #77228
    18.4
  • Obsolete messages could be more helpful #630
    Backlog
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build main-11517.59 #82437
  • [Automated] PRs inserted in VS build feature.debugger.wix5-11517.161 #82436
